messages:
alex-csm: Quick thread 45 we have ~85 impacted onboarding tenants in APAC, about 18 in <45d renewal window. Proposing a targeted outreach: short localized note, 30m remediation office hours, and a small goodwill credit. Need sign-off on cadence and credit bands.

hana-cs: Agree. APAC prefers morning slots. Suggest 3x 30m slots Mon/Wed/Fri 09:30 SGT and a recorded replay. Also add an explicit "No action needed" lead line for low-risk tenants.

piotr-eng: Tech update: ingestion delay caused by throttled queue during the deploy. We fixed the deploy and drained the queue; no vectors deleted. Recommend we advise customers NOT to re-run bulk ingest. I'll provide a 1-liner diagnostic (count check) for comms.

zoe-ops: Ops can staff APAC office hours next week. I'll create calendar link and escalation path. For credits, finance okayed small/medium/large tiers; CS to propose specific amounts per usage.

alex-csm: Draft email (EN) below, super short: 

"Hi <Customer>,
We experienced a temporary onboarding delay that may have affected embeddings for a subset of accounts. Engineers mitigated the issue; no data loss detected. If your search looks normal, no action required. If you see missing results, schedule a 30m remediation slot here: <cal_link>. We also offer a goodwill credit for impacted customers in renewal windows.
Thanks, Alex (CS)"

hana-cs: LGTM. Add sentence: "If your renewal is within 45 days we'll proactively reach out to schedule a 1:1."

piotr-eng: Diagnostic snippet (single line) to include: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/<index>/count`

zoe-ops: Action items: 1) alex finalize email and calendar link by EOD; 2) hana to get localized short copy for JP/KR/EN; 3) piotr confirm diagnostic endpoint and sign-off; 4) ops to prepare calendar + support auto-ticketing. I'll tag top 18 renewal-risk accounts for 1:1 outreach.

support-bot: Support ticket INC-APAC-2024-773 opened for proactive remediation requests.

alex-csm: Plan: send first wave to <45d cohort 08:00 SGT tomorrow, monitor responses for 1:1 escalations. Keep workshop focused 30m: quick RCA summary, verification steps, Q&A. We'll collect 2-question feedback after each session.

hana-cs: Short survey: 1) Did the session resolve your issue? (yes/no) 2) Any outstanding asks? Free text. Keep it tiny to maximize replies.

piotr-eng: I'll give final approval for public-facing wording on the RCA blurb by 21:00 PT.

zoe-ops: All set on operations side. Scheduling first wave tomorrow.

alex-csm: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the first wave to assess credit allocations and any high-touch follow-ups.
